title: [CON-9] §12.6 allows P-256 device keys, but the MLS ciphersuite, JWS and §2.2 are Ed25519-only
description: Review finding CON-9: §12.6 allows P-256 device keys, but the MLS ciphersuite, JWS and §2.2 are Ed25519-only (lens CON). Location: spec/12-security.md:89; also 12:91 ("MLS leaf operations ... MUST use keys held in the secure boundary", which cannot be met on Secure Enclave) and 12:121 ("generated inside the device's secure enclave"); spec/02-identity.md:80, :255; spec/05-messaging.md:46; spec/13-encoding.md:76. Fix: Delete the P-256 allowance (D6 fixes Ed25519). Relax 12:91 and 02:255 to "hardware-backed where the platform supports Ed25519, otherwise the best protected software store". Fix 12:121 to match. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: P-256 allowance removed; device keys Ed25519 only, hardware where platform supports Ed25519 else software/wrapped (spec/12-security.md §12.6 items for authentication key and MLS leaf; spec/02-identity.md §2.2 :85; spec/12-security.md §12.7.2)
